name: groq-translate
description: Translate whatever you type into one target language with a model on Groq before it reaches Claude, keeping code, paths and @file mentions verbatim. Claude receives only the translation.

language.title: Target language
language.description: The language every prompt is sent to Claude in, e.g. English.

enabled.title: On at session start
enabled.description: Whether translation is on when a session starts; /translate on|off changes it for the session.

groqApiKey.title: Groq API key
groqApiKey.description: Kept in secure storage, sent to Groq in the Authorization header.

groqModel.title: Groq model
groqModel.description: The Groq model id that translates. Empty: openai/gpt-oss-120b.
